description:
[Trading Data API] US equities market clock (is_open, next_open/close) + upcoming sessions, via Alpaca. Crypto endpoints are 24/7 and unaffected.

**Example:** `/v1/market-clock`

Use when you need to know whether US equity markets are open and when the next session opens or closes. Not for crypto, which trades 24/7.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

days.description: Optional. Upcoming session days to include (default 3, max 30; 0 to omit).

name: market_clock
